title: SEBI Mulls Depository Receipts (DRs) Against REIT and InvIT Units
summary: SEBI Mulls Depository Receipts (DRs) Against REIT and InvIT Units

items: Markets regulator SEBI proposed allowing REITs and InvITs to issue Depository Receipts (DRs) in foreign jurisdictions to attract foreign capital.

blocks.title: Exam Trap & Statutory Distinction
blocks.content: ⚠️ **Regulatory Compliance Trap:** Ensure exact compliance dates, institutional ceilings, and penalty provisions are verified during recall.
